clues: This old town sits in the southeast of Poland, on a wide river. It stands near the point where a second river joins it, in a basin.
Most of the rain here falls in summer, then it fades away bit by bit until winter ends. The year splits into four clear seasons, hot then cold.
This was a royal city of the Polish Crown long ago. From the High Middle Ages it ran the region for hundreds of years.
In twenty seventeen, its Old Town won a top state honour. The President of Poland gave that honour to the town that year.
Its preserved Old Town is a major sight for visitors and the marker this town is known for. It has kept its historic look through the ages.
